chunks: And with this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abu Abdillah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who has a Friday pass by him and does not recite in it 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' and then dies, dies upon the religion of Abu Lahab.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the profound spiritual weight of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas on Fridays, linking it to the preservation of pure monotheism (Tawhid). The comparison to Abu Lahab—a symbol of obstinate rejection of faith in the Quran—serves as a stark warning that neglecting this specific devotion may indicate a latent deficiency in one's creed or a return to pre-Islamic polytheistic inclinations at the time of death.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. And from the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abi Abdillah from Ishaq b. Ammar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who dies on Friday without having recited Surah Tauheed has died having faith on the religion of Abu Lahab.”
